No proof of purchase, receipt, or UK plug adapter shown.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, display lit, playing a short tune using multiple keys
Clear photo of the included adapter showing plug type and voltage rating
Close-up photos of the casing edges, battery compartment, and rear ports
Audio clip or video confirming no crackle in speaker output at moderate volume
response.reason: The seller's repeated verbal assurance adds no new visual evidence, so the keyboard remains identifiable as a Yamaha PSR-175 but must still be priced at worst case for unconfirmed working condition.
